scheme_name: SDRF/NDRF Housing Reconstruction & Repair Assistance
official_department: Disaster Management Division, Ministry of Home Affairs / SDMA
title: SDRF/NDRF Housing Reconstruction & Repair Assistance — Overview & Benefits
text:
Government Scheme: SDRF/NDRF Housing Reconstruction & Repair Assistance
Department: Disaster Management Division, Ministry of Home Affairs / SDMA
Disaster Type: flood
Scope: Central & State Co-funded
Relief Quantum / Amount: ₹1,01,900 per pucca house / ₹95,100 per katcha house
Eligibility Overview: Households with pucca or katcha residential houses severely damaged or destroyed by declared flood calamities. Applicant must be the owner or verified permanent resident. Damage assessment exceeding 33% certified by Revenue Inspector/Tehsildar.
Key Benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,01,900 for fully destroyed RCC/pucca house, Financial assistance of ₹95,100 for fully destroyed katcha dwelling, Assistance of ₹5,200 for partially damaged house (>15% damage), Immediate Gratuitous Relief: ₹2,000 for clothing & ₹2,000 for utensils per family
Official Source: Revised Norms of Assistance from SDRF and NDRF — Ministry of Home Affairs (2023) (https://ndma.gov.in/sites/default/files/PDF/sdrf-ndrf-norms-2023.pdf)
relief_amount: ₹1,01,900 per pucca house / ₹95,100 per katcha house
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,01,900 for fully destroyed RCC/pucca house
Financial assistance of ₹95,100 for fully destroyed katcha dwelling
Assistance of ₹5,200 for partially damaged house (>15% damage)
Immediate Gratuitous Relief: ₹2,000 for clothing & ₹2,000 for utensils per family
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of head of household
Bank Passbook copy (linked to Aadhaar for DBT)
Property Ownership Proof / Village Panchayat Residence Certificate
Geo-tagged damage photographs certified by field revenue inspector
Damage Assessment Survey Slip issued by Tehsildar
source_document: Revised Norms of Assistance from SDRF and NDRF — Ministry of Home Affairs (2023)

scheme_name: SDRF/NDRF Housing Reconstruction & Repair Assistance
official_department: Disaster Management Division, Ministry of Home Affairs / SDMA
title: SDRF/NDRF Housing Reconstruction & Repair Assistance — Claim Processing Timeline & Stages
text:
Claim Submission & Inspection Process for SDRF/NDRF Housing Reconstruction & Repair Assistance:
Responsible Authority: Disaster Management Division, Ministry of Home Affairs / SDMA
Official Application Process:
1. Submit damage claim dossier with evidence to local Gram Panchayat or Tehsildar office. 2. Revenue Inspector / Patwari conducts spot inspection within 7-10 days. 3. District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA) verifies claim list. 4. Sanction order issued and funds credited via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Typical Processing Window: 15 working days.
Source: Revised Norms of Assistance from SDRF and NDRF — Ministry of Home Affairs (2023)

scheme_name: SDRF Agricultural Crop Loss Compensation (Input Subsidy)
official_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Revenue Dept
title: SDRF Agricultural Crop Loss Compensation (Input Subsidy) — Overview & Benefits
text:
Government Scheme: SDRF Agricultural Crop Loss Compensation (Input Subsidy)
Department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Revenue Dept
Disaster Type: flood
Scope: Central & State Co-funded
Relief Quantum / Amount: ₹6,800 per hectare (Rainfed) / ₹13,500 per hectare (Irrigated)
Eligibility Overview: Small, marginal, and cultivating farmers with land records whose standing crops suffered 33% or higher loss due to inundation/submergence in notified flood areas. Assistance limited to maximum 2 hectares per farmer.
Key Benefits: Input subsidy of ₹6,800 per hectare for rainfed agriculture areas, Input subsidy of ₹13,500 per hectare for assured irrigated areas, Assistance of ₹18,000 per hectare for perennial horticulture crops, Desilting assistance: ₹12,200 per hectare for agricultural land siltation >3 inches
Official Source: National Agriculture Disaster Management Guidelines — Ministry of Agriculture (https://agricoop.gov.in/en/sdrf-ndrf-guidelines)

Input subsidy of ₹13,500 per hectare for assured irrigated areas
Assistance of ₹18,000 per hectare for perennial horticulture crops
Desilting assistance: ₹12,200 per hectare for agricultural land siltation >3 inches

Land Possession Certificate (LPC) / RoR (Khasra/Khatauni)

text:
Claim Submission & Inspection Process for SDRF Agricultural Crop Loss Compensation (Input Subsidy):
Responsible Authority: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Revenue Dept
Official Application Process:
1. Register claim at local Krishi Vigyan Kendra / Block Agriculture Office. 2. Joint field survey conducted by Agriculture & Revenue teams. 3. Beneficiary list published at Panchayat Bhawan for social audit. 4. District Collector sanctions DBT disbursement into farmer bank account.
Typical Processing Window: 21 working days.
Source: National Agriculture Disaster Management Guidelines — Ministry of Agriculture

scheme_name: State Disaster Response Emergency Fire Loss Relief Provision
official_department: Department of Revenue & Civil Defense / Fire Services
title: State Disaster Response Emergency Fire Loss Relief Provision — Overview & Benefits
text:
Government Scheme: State Disaster Response Emergency Fire Loss Relief Provision
Department: Department of Revenue & Civil Defense / Fire Services
Disaster Type: fire
Scope: State & Central SDRF Norms
Relief Quantum / Amount: ₹1,01,900 for pucca house / ₹95,100 for katcha house + Asset Grant
Eligibility Overview: Victims of non-industrial residential or community fire outbreaks in declared rural/urban localities. Must be certified by Fire Station Officer / Local Police Station (Fire Incident DDR/FIR) and revenue authority damage assessment.
Key Benefits: Immediate ex-gratia relief of ₹1,01,900 for fully gutted pucca structure, ₹95,100 for katcha/thatched house completely destroyed by fire, Utensils, clothing & household asset emergency grant of ₹4,000 per family, Immediate temporary shelter kit & 15-day community ration support
Official Source: MHA SDRF Fire Calamity Operational Norms & Guidelines (https://mha.gov.in/en/division-of-mha/disaster-management-division)

scheme_name: PMAY-G / State Housing Fire Reconstruction Special Grant
official_department: Ministry of Rural Development / State Housing Board
title: PMAY-G / State Housing Fire Reconstruction Special Grant — Overview & Benefits
text:
Government Scheme: PMAY-G / State Housing Fire Reconstruction Special Grant
Department: Ministry of Rural Development / State Housing Board
Disaster Type: fire
Scope: Central & State Joint Provision
Relief Quantum / Amount: ₹1,20,000 (Plain areas) / ₹1,30,000 (Hilly areas) Reconstruction Subsidy
Eligibility Overview: Families residing in rural or peri-urban areas whose sole dwelling was destroyed by accidental fire. Priority allotment under PMAY-G Special Calamity Quota upon certificate of unlivable condition.
Key Benefits: Direct grant of ₹1,20,000 for construction of disaster-resilient 25 sq.m pucca house, 90 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA (approx ₹20,000 additional), ₹12,000 assistance for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM-G), Free LPG connection under PM Ujjwala Yojana replacement provision
Official Source: PMAY-Gramin Calamity Reconstruction Framework — Ministry of Rural Development (https://pmayg.nic.in/)

Free LPG connection under PM Ujjwala Yojana replacement provision

official_department: NDMA / Ministry of Home Affairs / State Disaster Management Cell
title: National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) Seismic Damage Relief Package — Overview & Benefits
text:
Government Scheme: National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) Seismic Damage Relief Package
Department: NDMA / Ministry of Home Affairs / State Disaster Management Cell
Disaster Type: earthquake
Scope: National & State Co-funded
Relief Quantum / Amount: ₹1,01,900 (Full Collapse) / ₹35,000 (Major Structural Crack) / ₹5,200 (Partial)
Eligibility Overview: Owners of residential properties damaged by earthquake tremors in notified seismic zones. Damage assessed by structural engineer / revenue technical team verifying Grade 3, 4, or 5 structural failure.
Key Benefits: ₹1,01,900 for fully collapsed/unlivable pucca building, ₹35,000 for severely damaged house requiring structural retrofitting/reinforcement, ₹5,200 for minor plaster/wall crack repairs, ₹4,000 per family for clothing & household equipment replacement
Official Source: NDMA Guidelines for Management of Earthquakes & SDRF Norms (https://ndma.gov.in/Governance/Guidelines/Earthquake)
benefits: ₹1,01,900 for fully collapsed/unlivable pucca building
₹35,000 for severely damaged house requiring structural retrofitting/reinforcement
₹5,200 for minor plaster/wall crack repairs
₹4,000 per family for clothing & household equipment replacement

Property Ownership Certificate / Municipal Tax Assessment Receipt

Aadhaar-seeded Bank Passbook

official_department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / State Industries Dept
title: Earthquake Livelihood & Small Business Asset Restoration Scheme — Overview & Benefits
text:
Government Scheme: Earthquake Livelihood & Small Business Asset Restoration Scheme
Department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / State Industries Dept
Disaster Type: earthquake
Scope: State & Central MSME Scheme
Relief Quantum / Amount: Up to ₹50,000 Grant + Priority Mudra Loan / Interest Subvention
Eligibility Overview: Artisans, micro-entrepreneurs, roadside vendors, and small shopkeepers whose commercial inventory, machinery, or shop premises collapsed or suffered damage during earthquake.
Key Benefits: Immediate ex-gratia tool/equipment grant of ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 based on verified loss, Priority fast-track processing for PMMY (Mudra) reconstruction loan with 3% interest subvention, Moratorium on existing government-backed loan repayments for 6 months
Official Source: MSME Disaster Relief & Business Continuity Guidelines (https://msme.gov.in/schemes)
